data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were USD 203.187m. Using the gross claims development triangle the Syndicate recorded net adverse prior year development (gross strengthening) of USD 21.711m (10.7% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development on older underwriting years (notably 2015) partially offset by releases on earlier years (2014). Management links reserve movements to adverse claims development and large loss/catastrophe experience; the year also suffered major catastrophe activity (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquake, California wildfires) which materially affected the 2017 result.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred is an increase in incurred claims relating to 2016 and prior years of account of USD 50.3m (2016: increase in incurred claims relating to 2015 and prior years of account USD 26.3m).
This primarily resulted from the high frequency of catastrophe events experienced in the year, specifically hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexico earthquake, and California Wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the 'Provision for claims outstanding' table (gross column). No explicit single-line 'Movement in prior year's provision (gross)' was found; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 26) per the instructions. All amounts in the report are presented in USD'000; conversions to millions were done by dividing by 1,000. Some narrative reserve descriptions reference 'claims incurred' figures; the movement reported here was derived from the gross triangle rather than P&L 'claims incurred' lines to comply with the extraction rules.
